name: mxstermind-preview
description: Localhost preview server for the mxstermind SaaS branding wedge demo.

scripts.dev:all: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev" "npm run dev --prefix web"
scripts.cf:build: npm ci --prefix web --include=dev && npm run cf:build --prefix web
scripts.brandforge:deploy: npm ci --prefix brandforge --include=dev && npm run deploy --prefix brandforge
scripts.mxstermind:deploy: npm install --prefix mxstermind --include=dev && npm run deploy --prefix mxstermind
scripts.site:deploy: node site/scripts/inject-analytics.mjs && npx wrangler deploy --config site/wrangler.jsonc
